content.text: Submitted. The proposal now sits cleanly at the fallback level: one concise insertion after Section 16.2 adding Array's IP-infringement indemnity with the usual exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications), the procure/modify/replace/refund remedy ladder and a 3x annual fees super-cap. The prior double-sided rewrite (new limb (e) plus a mirrored carve-out from our Section 16.1(a)) and the "notwithstanding Section 11.4" override were dropped, clearing both the changed-character and expansion gates; the official IP-indemnity check now passes.
